description: MUTATES Parabol data: add a reflection card to a running retrospective's reflect phase. Required: meetingId, promptId (the reflect-prompt/column), sortOrder (Float). `content` (optional) is a stringified TipTap/ProseMirror JSON document (<=2000 chars). Parabol GraphQL: createReflection(input). Requires MEETINGS_WRITE.

content.description: Reflection text as a stringified TipTap/ProseMirror JSON document.

fields.description: Additional documented GraphQL input fields to send verbatim in this mutation's input (merged OVER the typed fields above).

sortOrder.description: Sort order within the column (Float). Defaults to 0.

name: create_reflection
title: Create a reflection
